name: Local Bridge
description: Mounts local machine directories at local/<host>/<root> and provides shell, search and stub tools.

name: Google Drive Sync
description: Mounts a Google Drive folder at drive/ and syncs it bi-directionally.

name: Web Search
description: Provides web_search / read_webpage / download_file tools to the AI.

name: Loom
description: Keeps a hash-checked index of the Loom board (data/apps/loom/*.md) and serializes every write to it. The Loom app draws; this daemon reads and writes. Provides loom_list / loom_search / loom_tree / loom_update / loom_append / loom_create / loom_status to the AI.
